products.name: Tutto Calabria Crushed Hot Chili Peppers, 290g
products.description: Tutto Calabria began production in the 1970's and was one of the first companies to introduce traditional Calabrian products to not only the Italian market, but also the world. These traditional Calabrian Peppers are crushed as is and mixed with olives, oil and vinegar. Spicy and full flavored, they are a great way to add some heat to your marinades, soups, spreads and pasta sauces.

products.name: Contadini Giardiniera, 330g
products.description: I Contadini, a brand from southern Puglia, gets its name from the Italian word for farmers. Sustainable farming methods, on-site processing, the fertile soil and plentiful sun of Puglia contribute to the unusually high quality of their produce. I Contadini La Giardiniera Pickled Vegetable Medley features the classic southern Italian preparation of crisp vegetables in a sweet and sour pickling mix. Great as an appetizer or as an addition to cold pasta dishes.

products.name: Bread Dip Company Feta & Pink Peppercorn 8oz
products.description: A local product that we are carried for years, the Bread Dip Company Feta & Pink Peppercorn is a wonderful cheese spread that goes great with any cracker or piece of grilled bread!

products.name: Bread Dip Company Olive & Herb, 8oz
products.description: A local product that we are carried for years, the Bread Dip Company Olive and Herb Tapenade is a perfect addition to your antipasti platter. Kalamata, Manzanilla, and Ripe Black Olives are blended with herbs and spices to create a great tapenade!

products.name: Bread Dip Company Sundried Tomato, 8oz
products.description: A local product that we have carried for years! The Bread Dip Company Sundried Tomato spread combines sun-ripened tomatoes with chunks of garlic, herbs and spices which are soaked in delicious extra virgin olive oil. Great with grilled bread or try a spoonful in your pasta!

products.name: Cascina Fiume Giardinetto Antipasto, 240g
products.description: A vibrant mix of peppers, carrots, cauliflower, courgette, onions, and tomatoes, all preserved in premium olive oil. The vegetables maintain their distinct flavors, with the olive oil enhancing their natural sweetness and earthy notes, while providing a smooth, silky texture. Perfect to be enjoyed both warm or cold!

products.name: Cascina Fiume Leek Spread, 180g
products.description:
Cascina Fiume has centered themselves in tradition and mission-driven work. Gastronomic Gardener is a term Enrico uses to describe their work. Not farmers and not chefs, but a collective of both, bringing the best from field to table.

Their Crema Dolce di Porri, Carmagnola Leek Spread, has a smooth, velvety texture with a delicate sweetness from the slow-cooked leeks. The aroma is subtly earthy, with rich, caramelized notes of leek that fill the air. On the palate, it delivers a refined balance of sweetness and mild onion-like flavor, creating a creamy, savory depth.

products.name: Cascina Fiume Ortolana Mixed Vegetables in Agrodolce, 570g
products.description:
Cascina Fiume has centered themselves in tradition and mission-driven work. Gastronomic Gardener is a term Enrico uses to describe their work. Not farmers and not chefs, but a collective of both, bringing the best from field to table.

Their Ortolana, is mixed vegetables in Agrodolce, a blend of peppers, carrots, cauliflower, zucchini and spring onions preserved in sweet and tangy agrodolce.

What is Agrodolce you ask? It translates to bittersweet, and is the Italian condiment you never knew you needed. Combining vinegar with some form of sugar (in Casina Fiumes case, a sweet wine) then adding fruit, nuts, herbs, and spices. This vibrant mix is ideal as an appetizer, side plate, an accompaniment to antipasti spreads, sandwiches, or charcuterie!

products.name: Cascina Fiume Sweet Onion Spread, 180g
products.description: Cascina Fiume has centered themselves in tradition and mission-driven work. Gastronomic Gardener is a term Enrico uses to describe their work. Not farmers and not chefs, but a collective of both, bringing the best from field to table. Their Crema Dolce, sweet onion spread, offers a perfect balance of sweetness and umami, with a delicate richness that lingers.

products.name: Suhey Hot Peppers, 15.5oz
products.description: What in the world is a Suhey Pepper, anyway? You mean besides being DeLaurenti Co-Owner Nate Plutko’s favorite peppers to put on burgers, brats & sandwiches? Glad you asked. Webster’s would define them as banana peppers in olive oil with garlic, cider vinegar and spices. Nate would say that he grew up eating them on everything in Pittsburgh and that you need to try them and that you will love them. Both things are true in this case! This is one of those “products” that knows few bounds. The breadth of their application is legendary. Tuna salad, pizza, hummus, tacos, sandwiches, pasta, avocado toast, skillet potatoes, cheese boards, cured meats, sauces…you get the point. I guess when you find something you really like to eat, you find ways to eat it with everything!

products.name: Partanna Muffuletta Mix, 550g
products.description: Italian Muffuletta you say? Yes. Invented by Sicilians in New Orleans and elevated by Sicilians in Castelvetrano. This muffuletta combines the best Sicilian olives and vegetables to create a salad that works perfectly with ANY sandwich!

products.name: Beaufor Gherkins in Vinegar, 350g
products.description: These gherkins add a nice tartness and texture to any cured meat, pate, and of course Raclette. Slice in half and enjoy on a sandwich with smoked meats and mustard, or chop and add to a remoulade or sauce paired with fish or chicken.

products.name: Big Picture Foods Organic Banana Peppers, 12oz
products.tagline: Yes...Nate puts these on his spaghetti. Don't knock it till ya try it!
products.description: Enhance your favorite recipes and some dramatic presentation! These bright, tangy Organic Banana Pepper Rings are regeneratively grown, sun ripened and conveniently pre-sliced. Always free from additives, stabilizers and preservatives - just sweet, robust flavor and endless possibilities! Just 4 ingredients: banana peppers, organic kosher wine vinegar, mineral water & unrefined sea salt!

products.name: Calpac Peeled Black Garlic, 2oz
products.description:
Local craftsman source, ferment and age this culinary gem using ancestral practices handed down through generations learned in Japan. Fermenting quality garlic with proper care and technique brings out its many layers of flavor. Notes of dried fig, raisin and balsamic are present along with aromas of black truffle and grape must.

Cal Pac peeled black garlic is used to add a sweet, savory, and umami-rich depth of flavor to dishes like pasta sauces, dressings, and marinades, often mashed or blended due to its soft texture. It's also great in compounds butters, mashed into potatoes or cauliflower, spread on toast, or used in unique desserts like savory ice cream.

products.name: Matiz Piparras Peppers
products.description: Matiz Piparra Peppers are a traditional long green pepper from the Basque Country of Spain. With a mild slightly pickled flavor, they make a wonderful accompaniment to bonita tuna and smoked fish, or try them drizzled with olive oil and salt. Feeling creative? Try them on a pizza, a burger, or use them at the perfect martini stirrer!

products.name: Seattle Pickle Co. Fresh Dill, 24oz
products.description: Seattle Pickle Co. makes awesome pickles. Hand packed right here in Seattle, this pickle will remind you of those days when you can smell the sweet salty-brinyness of the Pacific Ocean in the Puget Sound. They combine & brine only premium ingredients to give you a truly unique Pacific Northwest flavor and experience.

products.name: Seattle Pickle Co. Spicy Dill, 24oz
products.description: Seattle Pickle Co. makes awesome pickles. Hand packed right here in Seattle, this pickle will remind you of those days when you can smell the sweet salty-brinyness of the Pacific Ocean in the Puget Sound. They combine & brine only premium ingredients to give you a truly unique Pacific Northwest flavor and experience. Crunchy & delicious with a warm spice!

Super-sized for those people who burn through the peppers! 1 kilo of pure crushed pepper power!

products.name: Tutto Calabria Hot Spread Sauce, 290g
products.description: Tutto Calabria began production in the 1970's and was one of the first companies to introduce traditional Calabrian products to not only the Italian market, but also the world! This traditional Calabrian Hot Spread Sauce is a combination of long peppers, eggplant, tomatoes, garlic and vinegar. Warmly spiced, this sauce is perfect for anything from sandwiches, to pastas to condiments - it also makes a great topping for bruschetta.

products.name: Mama Lil's Kick Butt Peppers in Oil, 12oz
products.description: Son of the real Mama Lil, founder Howard Lev grew up eating his mother's peppers at every meal. These pickled goathorn peppers are grown and made in Washington's Yakima Valley. Packed in oil and a touch of garlic, these peppers are crunchy and bright with a spicy kick. Serve with antipasti, or use as a topping for pizzas and sandwiches. Added bonus - use the oil to spice up soups, sauces & pasta dishes!

products.name: Mama Lil's Mildly Spicy Peppers in Oil, 12oz
products.description: Son of the real Mama Lil, founder Howard Lev grew up eating his mother's peppers at every meal. These pickled goathorn peppers are grown and made in Washington's Yakima Valley. Packed in oil and a touch of garlic, these peppers are crunchy, bright and mildly spicy. Serve with antipasti, or use as a topping for pizzas and sandwiches. Added bonus - use the oil to spice up soups, sauces & pasta dishes!

products.name: Mama Lil's Sweet Hot Peppers, 12oz
products.description: Mama Lil’s is a Pacific Northwest Company that originated in Seattle in 1992 when Howard Lev made his first commercial batch of pickled Hungarian Goathorn Peppers from his mother’s (Lil Lev) recipe. He sold the pickled peppers at farmers markets before attracting the attention of local chefs. Since then, Mama Lil’s has grown exponentially and expanded their line of products, but has never stopped using fresh, locally-grown ingredients. Their Sweet Hot Peppas were what got Mama Lil’s started! They have a sweet spicy kick that won’t overwhelm your palate. Great on almost everything.

products.name: DeLaurenti Artichoke Spread
products.description: Enjoying a no frills artichoke spread and appreciating the finer things are not mutually exclusive. Correct, this is not the fanciest thing you will find at our store, but it is still one of the best. If you bring it to a friend's house for an appetizer, be prepared to have them ask you to bring it again and again. It is best enjoyed with grilled bread that has some crunch, or with Macrina's Apricot Nut Crostini. Want to know what's in it? Buy our cookbook! Portioned by hand when you order it!

products.name: DeLaurenti Hummus
products.description: Our housemade Hummus - better than any mass produced grocery store brand, and a lot easier than making it yourself! We use Rancho Gordo garbanzo beans, tahini, lemon juice, garlic, and olive oil. Serve with raw or grilled vegetables, crostini, or with grilled chicken, tzatziki sauce, pita, cucumbers and tomatoes. Portioned by hand when you order it!

products.name: DeLaurenti Salmon Spread
products.description: Our housemade salmon spread! Made with smoked coho salmon collars, crème fraiche, cream cheese, and chives. Great on a breakfast bagel or served with crackers for an appetizer. Portioned by hand when you order it!

products.name: La Medina Semi-Dried Tomatoes, 540g
products.description: These semi-sundried tomatoes are versatile, convenient and packed with flavor! They are hand-picked and hand-cut tomatoes marinated in sunflower oil, vinegar, herbs, spices and seasonings. Much more tender than sundried tomatoes, they are perfect for salads, pastas and pizza. No need to discard the oil, either - you can reuse it to marinate something else, use it for dressings, or incorporate it into mayonaisse.

products.name: Donostia Guindilla Peppers, 4.23oz
products.description: Donostia brings the culinary culture of Donostia-San Sebastián to kitchens across the United States with their line of select ingredients for authentic pintxos and tapas. Their Guindilla Peppers are pickled & moderately spicey with a subtle, fresh crunch. Perfect alongside a nice piece of manchego, piquillo peppers and serrano ham!

products.name: Maison Marc Aigre-Doux Cornichons, 310g
products.description: Call them what you want...pickles, cornichons, gherkins...these are quite possibly the best version of whatever name you use to describe them. Family-owned Maison Marc has been cultivating, picking and packing best pickles anywhere by hand on its farm in Chemilly-sur-Yvonne in Burgundy for three generations. No herbicides, no insecticides, no preservatives...just pickles & a lot of expertise.Their Aigre-Doux cornichons are sweet & sour with a touch of warm pimenton. Perfect right from the jar, with pate, on sandwiches or with your next charcuterie board.

products.description:

products.name: DeLaurenti Dolmas
products.description: The DeLaurenti antipasti case classic! Perhaps the best deal in the Market for a quick snack or as an addition to your antipasti spread. What are they? Good question: Tender grape leaves stuffed with rice, sauteed onions & herbs. Bite size and made for walking & eating!

products.name: DeLaurenti Gigandes
products.description: These beans have been a deli favorite for years. Meaty, but creamy in texture, they are marinated in oil & vinegar and combined with ribbons of sweet peppers. Great as an addition to your antipasti platter, on a salad or right out of the container!

products.name: DeLaurenti Peperonata
products.description: If you have these in your fridge, you have options. Made in our kitchen upstairs, these are handcut strips of whole sweet red & yellow peppers are marinated in oil/vinegar, garlic, herbs & spices. Not spicy, just delicious. They are great alongside cured meats, on a sausage or tuna sandwich or on pizza. Why do it yourself when we've already done it for you?

products.name: DeLaurenti Pepper Delights
products.description: These pepper shooters have been a DeLaurenti favorite for many years, attracting people from far and wide to come to our store to get their fix. They are crunchy, not too spicy green cherry peppers stuffed with prosciutto and provolone. Quarter or half them and add them to your antipasto tray, or eat them whole right from the container! There are approximately 10 to 12 peppers per pound.

products.name: Casina Rossa Homemade Antipaso, 280g
products.description: Ritrovo Selections is a premium importer of foods that represent Italy’s traditions and quality. Ritrovo means to rediscover in Italian. Over the last 20 years, the Seattle-based company has vastly expanded its line of products and won numerous international awards for quality. Casina Rossa is one of their original lines. This sweet and savory blend of Mediterranean vegetables, Italian pine nuts, and raisins dresses up pasta dishes and salads, makes a delightful side dish, or use as part of an appetizer tray.

products.name: Cuoco Caponata, 7oz
products.description: Cuoco Brand hails from Sicily. Their Caponata di Melenzane Eggplant Appetizer is a flexible sauce, excellent either hot or cold, as an appetizer with bread or crackers, or as a sauce for meats and vegetables or pasta. Made with eggplant, tomatoes, celery, onions, olives, and capers.

products.name: Bread Dip Company Artichoke & Caper, 8oz
products.description: A local product that we are carried for years, the Bread Dip Company Artichoke & Caper spread is a great savory blend of artichoke hearts and capers with lemon and herbs. Great on a grilled piece of bread or use a spoonfull in a vinaigrette!

products.name: Cascina Fiume Bagnet Verd Salsa Piemontese, 200g
products.description:
Bagnet Verd Salsa Piemontese al Prezzemolo offers a fresh, herbaceous experience with a smooth yet slightly textured consistency. The bright aroma of parsley combines with subtle garlic and olive oil notes. On the palate, it delivers a harmonious balance of herbal freshness and rich olive oil, with a gentle garlic heat. This versatile sauce adds a burst of freshness, showcasing the

high-quality ingredients of the Piedmont region.

products.name: Divina Roasted Red Peppers, 16.2oz
products.description: Divina whole roasted and handpicked red peppers are savory, full-bodied, and ready to go right out of the jar. Everything you love about a roasted pepper, perfect for salads, pizza, or antipasti.

products.name: Divina Roasted Yellow Peppers, 13oz
products.description: Divina whole roasted and handpicked yellow peppers are savory, full-bodied, and ready to go right out of the jar. Everything you love about a roasted pepper, perfect for salads, pizza, or antipasti.

products.name: Fratelli Polli Italian Antipasto, 7.4oz
products.description: Fratelli Polli is an Italian food company from Milan formed in 1872. They produce a range of preserved vegetables and sauces sold in glass jars. Their Italian Antipasto is a mix of vegetables and tuna in a tomato sauce. It’s excellent served as an appetizer, as a flavorful spread for sandwiches, or add it to a basic marinara sauce and use it as a pasta sauce.

products.name: Italbrand Roasted Red Peppers, 12oz
products.description: Not wanting to roast your own peppers is not a defeat. Let yourself off the hook and enjoy these sweet & tender peppers on everything from a sausage sandwich, to pizza to antipasti. They are great as is, or marinated (after cutting them into strips) with olive oil, garlic, herbs and a pinch of red pepper flakes!

products.name: La Pastora Drop Peppers, 145g
products.description: lágrima or teardrop peppers are petite, tear-shaped gourmet peppers pickled in a light sweet-and-sour brine. They feature a vibrant red color, a crisp and firm texture, and a unique flavor profile balancing sugary fruitiness with a mild, tangy finish.

products.name: Mahjoub Preserved Lemons, 200g
products.description: With over 100 years of experience in agriculture, the family owned Les Moulins Mahjoub focuses on producing the highest quality products by using careful harvesting methods and small scale production. An essential ingredient in North African cuisine, preserved lemons offer a sour and zesty balance against sweet, floral and spicy notes. Packed whole with a mild red pepper, these lemons are perfect with roasted chicken, grilled fish or dropped into stews & tangines. This is just the beginning, the list of uses goes on - pasta, lamb, tapenade, grains, roasted potatoes - any time you can use a lemon, you can use a preserved lemon.

products.name: Mama Lil's Pickled Asparagus, 28oz
products.description: Son of the real Mama Lil, founder Howard Lev grew up eating his mother's peppers at every meal. This asparagus is made in Washington's Yakima Valley. Sweet and spicy, they are perfect served on a veggie platter or used as a garnish in your Bloody Mary.

products.name: Mama Lil's Pickled Green Beans, 28oz
products.description: Son of the real Mama Lil, founder Howard Lev grew up eating his mother's peppers at every meal. These green beans are made in Washington's Yakima Valley. Spicy, zingy, and crisp, serve on a veggie platter or use as garnish in your Bloody Mary.

products.name: Matiz Piquillo Peppers, 7.6oz
products.description: Pure Piquillo peppers carry the exclusive seal of authenticity granted only to those peppers that are hand-picked in the Ribera del Ebro region of Northern Spain. The Piquillo pepper, meaning "little beak" for its distinctive pointed shape, is perfect in addition to you Chorizo and Manchego charcuterie board as well as on top of your Paella!

products.name: Ronnie's Giardiniera, 8.5oz
products.description: Ronnie's Giardiniera (jar-din-air-uh), is a small-batch, handcrafted, Chicago style condiment, however made in Seattle, with a bold kick that transforms any dish into a culinary adventure. It’s made of fresh cut, never frozen, non-GMO hot peppers, sweet peppers, vegetables and spices in extra virgin olive oil. Whether layered on sandwiches, spooned over eggs and burgers, mixed into hummus, or topped on pizza, Ronnie's Giardiniera brings the heat and the flavor. Bonus? The leftover oil is liquid gold -- perfect for sautéing or bread dipping. It’s The Missing Condiment - use it on anything!

products.name: Sable & Rosenfeld Olive Bruschetta, 454g
products.description: This is a flavorful blend of green olives, carrots, cauliflower, red bell pepper, celery and capers in olive oil. Perfect on sandwiches, grilled bread, pizza, salads, pasta, chicken or potato salad.

products.name: Sable & Rosenfeld Spicy Olive Bruschetta, 454g
products.description: This is a flavorful blend of black and green olives, jalapeno and habanero peppers, carrots and capers in olive oil. Perfect on sandwiches, pizzas, salads, pastas, chicken or grilled fish.

products.name: That Pickle Guy Hot Giardiniera, 16oz
products.description: A Chicago native moved to New Orleans and was desperate for some familiar food. Armed with some family recipes and a passion to create a winning giardiniera and muffaletta mix - That Pickle Guy was born. After leaving the corporate life, Greg Frederick put his small business ideas into motion. Beginning at farmer's markets in the Chicago area, The Pickle Guy is now found in dozens of stores across the country! So, what is giardiniera? Chicago-style, minced fresh pickled vegetables. Toss this into sauces, pasta, soups, chili, stir fry, roasts, sandwiches, pizza, hot Dogs, fajitas, salads or eggs...the options are endless!

products.description: Tutto Calabria is a 50-year old, family-run business that aims to share the wonderful flavors of their native Calabria (toe of the boot) with the rest of the world. Tutto Calabria’s founding family, the Cellis, know peppers. They’ve been harvesting them from the hillsides of Calabria since 1910. These pickled chilies are tangy, bright, and spicy. They’re an excellent way to add some spice to your next sandwich or pasta sauce.

products.name: Tutto Calabria Hot Long Chili Peppers, 290g
products.description: Tutto Calabria began production in the 1970's and was one of the first companies to introduce traditional Calabrian products to not only the Italian market, but also the world. These traditional Calabrian long peppers are marinated in oil and vinegar. Spicy, but not overwhelming, use them whole, chopped, or pureed to add some warm spice to your sauces, marinades, salad dressings and condiments.

products.name: Tutto Calabria PepperO' Hot/Sweet Cherry Peppers, 300g
products.description: Tutto Calabria is a 50-year old, family-run business that aims to share the wonderful flavors of their native Calabria (toe of the boot) with the rest of the world. These pickled peppers are the perfect balance of spicy and sweet. Soft, with just a hint of crunch, a few on your sandwich can transform your ho-hum lunch into a southern Italian classic.

products.name: Tutto Calabria Stuffed Cherry Peppers with Fresh Italian Cheese, 290g
products.description: Tutto Calabria is a 50-year old, family-run business that aims to share the wonderful flavors of their native Calabria (toe of the boot) with the rest of the world. Each plump Calabrian pepper is stuffed with PDO Quartirolo Lombardo cheese, for a North-meets-South punch of flavor and texture. Mild peppers allow the subtle tartness of the cheese to shine. These peppers are a crunchy-creamy delight. Great for snacking, on top of pizza, in pasta dishes or sandwiches. Not sure how they get the cheese in there and then get them into the jar. This isn’t our concern…our job is to eat them.
